levels._source: plan rev3 A4: the 4th slot of the A1 comparison set (same 3 fixed members per A1 draw, paired with A1) is replaced by a KB-overlap level: L0 = category != KB and far band (d > q_far) to KB; L1 = same category, middle band (q_nb < d <= q_far); L2 = same category, neighbour band (d <= q_nb); L3 = the KB site's own extra 3,000 documents (A0 role l3, disjoint from bank and queries). Our choices: the level site is drawn at random within its band per draw (seeded); candidates exclude KB, O, the fixed members and sites in O's neighbour band (A1 lesson: a KB-near slot that is also O-near mixes gain and cost); if L2 (or L1) is empty the nearest (median-rank) same-category site is used and flagged (plan rev3 A4 fallback by rank)
levels._fallback: per draw (review 2026-10-06: plan A4 words it per KB): a band is empty either for the KB or after excluding O's neighbour band; then L2 = nearest same-category candidate, L1 = median-rank same-category candidate (flag level_fallback); draws with no same-category candidate have no L1/L2 (counted in the summary)
levels._estimands: primary (plan): level curve and L1/L2/L3 - L0 in d'. Co-reported (review 2026-10-06, fixed before the run): O-distance-adjusted level costs from a regression of d' on level dummies + the slot's tag rank to O with (KB, O, draw) fixed effects (L3 slot = the KB site itself); two-sided clean draws (L0 and the level site both in O's far band); costs by tier with and without fallback draws. Levels also differ in proximity to O (L2 closer to O than L0 in ~72% of draws), so the unadjusted curve mixes the overlap cost with the RQ3 gain
